definitions.explanation: Something hung on a wall, such as a decorative cloth or picture, or, before another noun, the wall-mounted version of an appliance or fixture: {壁掛|かべか}け{時計|どけい}, {壁掛|かべか}けテレビ.

examples.japanese: {壁掛|かべか}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{壁掛|かべか}け⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: We installed a wall-mounted TV in the living room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{織物|おりもの}→織物：10583_orimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{壁掛|かべか}けにして⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}っている→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I hang a woven cloth I bought on a trip on the wall of my room as a decoration.

notes:
From ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (wall) + {掛|か}ける (to hang). Before a noun it may take ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or attach directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁掛|かべか}け{時計|どけい}: wall clock
- {壁掛|かべか}け⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧: wall-mounted TV
- {壁掛|かべか}け⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: wall-mounted air conditioner
- {壁掛|かべか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hang on the wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧: hanging scroll — the traditional Japanese scroll for the alcove, not a general wall hanging
